messages:
Riley Park: quick heads-up 1: we need to finalize the observability MVP scope for billing + errors. customers pushing for route-level cost and a lightweight trace sampling mode.
Nina Alvarez: agree. prioritize per-route cost + error trends. tracing should be opt-in sampling to avoid blowups.
Devon Li: note: cost attribution requires token-level accounting or a proxy estimate. full token accounting adds ~30% ingestion CPU. do we accept that?
Priya Rao: proposal: use token-estimates at request time (cheap) and store that with trace metadata. nightly backfill can reconcile differences for high-value accounts.
Riley Park: sounds reasonable. MVP: show "estimated spend" by route; mark it as estimated. Advanced view: reconciled/accurate numbers for committed customers.
Nina Alvarez: UX idea: single table with tiny sparkline + columns: est_spend, p95_ms, error_rate, sampled_traces. click row -> pane with traces (sampled only) + cost breakdown by model family.
Devon Li: tracing payload minimal: trace_id | route | model_family | tokens_est | duration_ms | status. keep it under 1KB. sampling defaults: 0.5% global, 5% for debug-flagged routes.
Priya Rao: alerting: simple presets only. notify if route_error_rate > 0.75% over 10m or est_spend > baseline * 1.5. No rule language for now.
Riley Park: launch criteria draft: (A) dashboard shows per-route est_spend and matches synthetic within 7%. (B) sampled traces show helpful fields for >85% of sampled. (C) alert presets present and can be attached to routes.
Nina Alvarez: timeline: if we reuse existing metrics pipeline -> 4 weeks (frontend + wiring). if new aggregation -> 7-9 weeks. need sign-off on estimates by Thu.
Devon Li: privacy/regulatory note: traces must strip PII. we will include only identifiers and hashes for prompts. ops: add scrubber in ingest pipeline.
Priya Rao: pilot plan: x-customer beta with 3 customers for 2 weeks, collect feedback on accuracy and UX. opt-in for private tenants.
alert-bot: alert: perf-test-deploy passed for obs-mvp-proto (2026-03-20T09:15Z).
Riley Park: next: Nina to draft mock rows, Devon to confirm ingest CPU delta, Priya to write pilot invite. we'll decide on aggregation approach Thursday. thanks.
